body:
### Problem
`system_reviews.finish` files the finding tasks, marks the run as ended (`put_run`), and only then adds the SYSTEMREVIEWS.md entry. If adding the entry fails, the run is already marked ended. When the agent retries, `finish` sees the ended run, returns success early, and tells the agent the review "was logged in SYSTEMREVIEWS.md", but no entry is ever written. This breaks D-265 point 3: every completed review adds one entry.

### Done when
- A run is marked ended only after its SYSTEMREVIEWS.md entry has been written.
- If writing the entry fails, `finish` reports the failure, and a retry writes the entry without filing the findings twice or adding a second entry.
- The agent is told the review was logged only when it was.
- Tests cover a failed log write followed by a retry, the early return for a run that has really ended, and the rollback when writing the finding tasks fails.
title: sysreview: every finished review is logged
